lead: 独立开发的几款小工具，覆盖 Mac、Windows 和乐奇 AI 眼镜。每一次发布都记录在这里。

products.name: KVMini
products.desc: 一套键盘鼠标控制 Mac 和 Windows 两台电脑。连上即用，复制的文字、图片、富文本和文件都能直接在另一台粘贴。全程 TLS 加密。
products.note: Windows 版即将提供；两台电脑请安装同一版本。
products.desc_en: One keyboard and mouse for your Mac and Windows computers. Connect and go — copied text, images, rich text and files paste straight onto the other computer. TLS encrypted end to end.
products.note_en: Windows version coming soon; please install the same version on both computers.

products.name: SnipScribe
products.desc: 菜单栏截屏识字：框选屏幕，文字直接进剪贴板，全程离线。

downloads.label: App Store · 中国区（名为 OneNoteCopy）

products.desc_en: Screenshot-to-text in the menu bar: select part of the screen and the text goes straight to your clipboard, fully offline.

products.name: MovieBox
products.desc: 本地优先的视频管理器：多目录扫描、隐私遮罩、加密保险箱、重复检测、人物归类。
products.desc_en: A local-first video manager: multi-folder scanning, privacy masking, an encrypted vault, duplicate detection and grouping by person.

products.name: 图谱
products.desc: 乐奇 Rokid AI 眼镜上的乐谱浏览器与提词器：镜腿翻页、自动滚动、节拍器、倒计时。
products.desc_en: A sheet music viewer and teleprompter for Rokid AI glasses: swipe the temple to turn pages, auto-scroll, metronome, countdown.

lead_en: A few small tools built by an independent developer, for Mac, Windows and Rokid AI glasses. Every release is recorded here.
